text.p: These are the headlines from selected Canadian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ontario MPPs dig in for ordeal: Reading of 12,500 amendments to contentious megacity bill could stall house for weeks.
- Somalia inquiry gets new directions: Cover-up claims can be ignored.
- Political crisis erupts in Zaire: Prime Minister offers rebels a deal.
- Kohl to run for fifth term as Chancellor: German leader vows to push ahead with reform plans, European monetary union.
- Financial abuse of elderly hits close to home: Study calls daughters worst offenders, estimates seniors could be losing millions.
- OSC reveals Bre-X probe: Says it began investigating insider trading by Walsh and other executives late last year.
- Bre-X's Busang stake not set in stone: Ownership breakdown will depend on size of gold deposit.
- Pent-up demand fuels auto sales: Consumer confidence, incentives, low rates drive 17 percent gain.
- Telesat wins approval to fly DTH satellite: Project to ease capacity shortage.
- Busang has gold, report says: Kilborn confirms earlier Bre-X assays, but carefully avoids estimates of discovery's size. Report suggests ore samples not tampered with.
- Three-year party may be over for equity funds.
